module: Test drive of a vehicle at a dealership in career. start() puts the player in the vehicle, creates a snapshot of the part conditions (key "beforeTestDrive"), disables autosave and activates the test drive. Each frame, onUpdate counts down the time limit (timeLimit), checks that the player stays within 10 m of the vehicle (otherwise abandon with fees) and detects damage every 2 s. stop() brings the vehicle back to the starting point with a fade and puts the player back on foot.
usage:
career_modules_testDrive.start(vehId, {timeLimit = 120, abandonFees = 50, dealershipName = "x", route = "y"})
if career_modules_testDrive.isActive() then print(career_modules_testDrive.getTimeLeft()) end
notes: testDriveInfo fields used in the code: timeLimit (s), abandonFees, endParkingSpot, endParkingSpotCreated, dealershipName, route, dealershipPreview.
The time limit is counted down in simulation time (dtSim). When it runs out, stop(false) is called (without the onGameplayActivityAborted hook).
abandonTestDrive: if abandonFees > 0, pays the fees (canBeNegative = true); private sales have no fees. Then calls career_modules_inspectVehicle.onTestDriveAbandoned().

stop(userAborted) emits onGameplayActivityAborted unless userAborted == false; it re-enables autosave and launches the end job (teleport to the starting point, time speed 0.5 then 1, navigation to the play screen, onTestDriveEndedAfterFade hook).
Emitted hooks: onTestDriveStarted (at start), onTestDriveEndedAfterFade (at end).
The test drive end POI (type testDriveEnd) is added to the raw POI list and a "stopTestDrive" action is added to the radial menu (level /root/sandbox/career/) on first opening.

start.desc: Starts the test drive: copies testDriveInfo, puts the player in the vehicle, remembers its starting position/rotation, creates and selects the beforeTestDrive parts snapshot, unfreezes the vehicle, emits onTestDriveStarted, clears the raw POIs and disables autosave.

_vehicleId.desc: Object id of the test drive vehicle.

testDriveInfo.desc: Test drive parameters (timeLimit, abandonFees, endParkingSpot, dealershipName, route...).

stop.desc: Ends the test drive normally (no effect if inactive): re-enables autosave and launches the end job that teleports the vehicle to the start with a fade.

abandonTestDrive.desc: Abandons the test drive (no effect if inactive): deactivates the test drive, re-enables autosave, then after 0.2 s displays and pays any abandon fees, resets the data and notifies inspectVehicle.

resetData.desc: Deactivates the test drive and clears the raw POIs.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether a test drive is in progress.

getTimeLeft.desc: Remaining test drive time in seconds (nil if there is no test drive or no limit).

isDamageDetected.desc: Indicates whether damage was detected on the vehicle during the test drive (detection by career_modules_insurance_insurance.genericVehNeedsRepair).

formatTestDriveToRawPoi.desc: Adds to elements the test drive end POI (id testDrive-<dealership>-<route>-parkingEnd, parking marker and big map marker) if an end spot exists and was created.

elements.desc: List of raw POIs to fill.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: if a test drive is active, handles the time limit, the player moving away and damage detection.

onVehicleRepairedByInsurance.desc: Hook called after an insurance repair: displays the repair cost after 1.8 s (real-time message and purchase sound).

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: POI list hook: adds the test drive end POI via formatTestDriveToRawPoi.

onPoiDetailPromptOpening.desc: POI detail open hook: if it is the testDriveEnd POI, adds a "stop the test drive" button calling stop(false).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: resets the test drive data when the career is activated.

onBeforeRadialOpened.desc: Hook before the radial menu opens: once only, adds a "stop the test drive" entry (visible only during a test drive) to the quick menu.
